title: Bataan Peninsula State Uni grad tops midwives licensure exam
summary: A graduate of Bataan Peninsula State University achieved the highest score in the licensure examination for midwives held earlier this month.

blocks.text: A graduate of Bataan Peninsula State University achieved the highest score in the licensure examination for midwives held earlier this month.
According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 1,343 out of 2,632 test takers passed the exam, given by the Board of Midwifery at 18 test centers across the country.
BPSU's Angela Maree Dela Torre Limcangco was the top scorer with a result of 93.50%, while the top performing schools were:

items: with 50 or more test takers: State University of Northern Negros, with 49 of 52 passing (94.23% success rate)
with 20 to 49 test takers: Makilala Institute of Science and Technology, with 19 of 20 passing (95.00% success rate)
